title: Automated Legal Deposition Archiving
business: A boutique law firm managing high volumes of recorded legal depositions.
problem: Manual transcription services are slow and prone to errors in technical legal terminology, leading to delays in case preparation and increased operational costs.
solution: The firm integrates GPT-4o Mini Transcribe to automate the conversion of audio deposition files into high-accuracy text transcripts, leveraging the model's improved language recognition capabilities to handle complex legal jargon.
steps: Capture high-quality audio files from deposition sessions.
Authenticate the application with the OpenAI API using the gpt-4o-mini-transcribe model ID.
Submit audio files to the v1/audio/transcriptions endpoint.
Retrieve the generated text output for review by legal assistants.
Store the validated transcripts in the firm's secure document management system.
outcome: The firm achieves faster turnaround times for case documentation, allowing legal teams to search and analyze testimony immediately after sessions conclude.
limitation: The model may struggle with heavy background noise or overlapping speech, which can be checked by monitoring the word error rate in the returned transcriptions against known reference segments.
